scientific_integrity: Exact universal analytical proof; exact finite computations provide corroboration, not exhaustive/infinite certification. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Only real coefficient matrices and uniform fixed-cardinality signed nonattacking rook placements; fourth moments. Higher moments, complex phases, rectangular boards, and biased sampling are not covered. Searches do not rule out unindexed prior equivalent results.
title: Fixed-rank signed-rook fourth moments: a one-third transition and additive minimizers
